description: Issue #31's last criterion, through the real menus with fresh user data: Koa (whose own craft is the Swordfish) picks the Petrel on the craft select, sets both records on Gull Cove, and the course select then names the Petrel with Koa for both records. Racing Gull Cove again, the ghost rides the Petrel's scene, drawn as a ghost in Koa's colours, on the recorded line. craft_hull_time_trial.scenario.json checks that a ghost draws its craft's own hull.

steps.name: fresh user data: no record and no ghost on Gull Cove
Koa's own craft, the Swordfish, has the focus first
down moves to the Petrel, not Koa's own craft
the Petrel is chosen; Gull Cove has no record yet
Koa rides the Petrel for three laps, with no ghost yet
the computer rides the run at skill 0.9, as the other time-trial scenarios do
the run ends with the time trial results
the records and the ghost keep Koa and the Petrel

steps.expect:
[scene.selected.id, scene._records.text.get_slice('
', 0).begins_with('RECORD   '), scene._records.text.get_slice('
', 0).ends_with('  (KOA, PETREL)'), scene._records.text.get_slice('
', 1).begins_with('BEST LAP   '), scene._records.text.get_slice('
', 1).ends_with('  (KOA, PETREL)'), scene._records.text.contains('SWORDFISH')]
steps.name: the course select names the Petrel, not Koa's Swordfish, for both records

steps.expect: [time_trial.ghost != null, time_trial.ghost_craft.id, time_trial.record_rider, time_trial.record_craft, time_trial.ghost.get_child_count(), time_trial.ghost.get_child(0).scene_file_path, time_trial.ghost.get_child(0).ghost]
steps.name: the ghost rides the Petrel, drawn as a ghost, with only the craft's model

steps.expect: [time_trial.ghost_craft == Game.craft_named('petrel'), time_trial.ghost_craft.scene == Game.craft_named('petrel').scene, time_trial.ghost.get_child(0).hull_color == Game.rider_named('Koa').hull_color, time_trial.ghost.get_child(0).trim_color == Game.rider_named('Koa').trim_color, time_trial.ghost.get_child(0).suit_color == Game.rider_named('Koa').suit_color]
steps.name: the ghost's model comes from the Petrel's scene, in Koa's colours
after 2.5 s the ghost has ridden over 10 m ahead of the waiting player
12.5 s in, the ghost is where the saved run was
